notes: Recipe of the W1 predictor zoo (plan docs/plans/2026-10-09-data-windows.md, 'Zoo grid'): 5 models x 4 losses x 2 regimes, plus two baselines in the same regimes, every lane scored on the same W1 walk-forward by PanelScore. Regime 'pooled' is one trunk and head over BTC and ETH with an asset indicator; 'per asset' is one lane per asset (so a pooled cell is one lane and its unpooled twin is two). `python -m crypto_trading.zoo_lanes configs/zoo-lanes-recipe.json --out configs/workflow-zoo-w1.json --w2-out configs/workflow-zoo-w2.json` writes the manifests; a test pins the shipped files to a fresh generation. Panel, window, folds, training, grid and zoo settings are inherited from `base` (the selection manifest), so the zoo and the selection cannot disagree on rows, folds or loss. Hyperparameters: children/index_options/configs/advanced-cdf-zoo.json (pooled PatchTST 64 wide, 3-component mixture, lr 3e-4, weight decay 0.01, patience 20) and run-pooled-zoo-417.json (GRU/LSTM, lr grid 3e-4..3e-3); the 1D-CNN is dskit's tcn arch with kernel 3 and dilations 1..16 (receptive field 63 >= the 60-bar window, refused at build otherwise). Run: `python -m dskit.pipeline workflow-batch configs/workflow-zoo-w1.json --root pipeline_runs/zoo-w1 --parallel 1` on ONE GPU lane at a time; `--only-lanes <lane>` for one cell. The zoo is not run until the owner approves epochs/stride/folds from the GPU probe.

args.notes: Inherited from the selection manifest (workflow-select-sequence.json) except `features`, `arms` (the lane names) and `cell` (each lane's full fit/score params, generated). `features.context` is the selected feature set: replace it with {"names": <selected-features-<class>.json columns>} (or overlay with --args) and regenerate; the default is every family, i.e. the selection's `all` arm.

panel.notes: Where the zoo's minute panel is read: the onboarded store (the one absolute path a run config may carry) and the localblobs source panel-minute registered from configs/source-panel-minute.json; relpath is the panel directory inside that stream (W1 + embargo + W2 bars, built by run-panel-build.json). Names, never file paths.

window.notes: W1, the selection window (owner-approved 2026-10-09, UTC, end EXCLUSIVE): 2023-06-20 up to but excluding 2026-05-01. The end is the plan's W1/W2 boundary: nothing at or after it is read, fitted or scored here. start_ms and end_ms are the same instants in epoch ms for the row filter; a test pins the pairs. `assets` names the two assets of the feature node, BTC first. `groups` are the panel's integer asset codes (MinuteFeatures codes an asset by its position in `assets`: BTC 0, ETH 1; a test pins it).

folds.notes: Explicit expanding walk-forward schedule on W1 only: the train window is everything before the cutoff minus the embargo, and the validation window is val_days from the cutoff. 14 folds of 60 days from 2024-01-01 end 2026-04-21, inside W1, and clear the rule's floor of 8. The 1-day embargo purges the labels' 15-minute reach. A test pins the schedule inside W1; the panel itself also holds W2, which no fold reaches.

training.notes: Fixed across every arm and both classes. Hyperparameters are the options child's pooled settings (children/index_options/configs/advanced-cdf-zoo.json `training`: 3 components, lr 0.0003, weight decay 0.01, patience 10 (owner 2026-10-10; the options studies used 20), 500-epoch ceiling, batch 512, seed 11, CRPS + tail CRPS weight 1 each); the Gaussian family and min_scale 0.1 are provisional. One seed per run (loader.seed): more seeds = rerun with --args overlaying `training.seed`. The fold score is crps + tail_weight * tail_crps on the common grid. Epochs/batch are provisional until the GPU probe sizes them. row_stride 5 (owner, 2026-10-10): the fit band trains on every 5th minute by clock phase (adjacent minutes are near-duplicates; ~45 s/epoch at full resolution made the study ~175 h); calibration and validation rows, the scaler and every window are NOT thinned, so scoring is still every minute.

grid.notes: What the score node evaluates: every horizon the feature node labels (1 to 15), on one common grid (z in label units, i.e. vol-standardised log return; the wings are provisional: a wing is fixed in z, so at h=15 where the spread is about sqrt(15) times h=1 it covers more of the bulk -- an open decision). tail_weight must equal the tail_crps weight in training.losses (a test pins it); the wings in training and scoring are the SAME list (the head reads grid.common.tail_intervals).

zoo.notes: The panel models' shared settings, fixed across arms. window/stride: the raw sequence is `window` bars spaced `stride` minutes (60 x 1 = the last hour); min_run = (window-1)*stride+1 is the panel-level gap rule (a test pins it) and is the same for the tabular class so both see identical rows. cal_days: the last days of each fold's train period feed the early-stopping loss. The trunk and PatchTST encoder are the options child's PatchTST/TorchCDF settings (advanced-cdf-zoo.json pooled candidate: d_model 64, 1 layer, patch 4/3, ffn 128, dropout 0.1; run-pooled-zoo-417.json trunk). Window length, cal_days and these widths are provisional until the GPU probe.

features.notes: The selected feature set, as a ColumnSelector over the panel's summary columns (never the raw seq__ channels, which the sequence models read separately). Default = all families (the selection's `all` arm); the selection output fills it: {"names": [...]} from selected-features-<class>.json.

cell.notes: Generated by crypto_trading.zoo_lanes from zoo-lanes-recipe.json: each lane's full fit and score params. Edit the recipe, never this block.

lanes.notes: One chain per cell: `$lane` binds the cell name and `cell` (keyed by lane) is narrowed to the lane's own entry.

fit.notes: One walk-forward per cell; its summary lands under the layout's `runs` directory.
The as-of date is W1's end, so run names say what the data stops at.
